=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .claude/hooks/settings_load_recorder.py:86-88,107 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The ConfigChange handler reads `config_source` and `config_file_path` instead of the payload fields `source` and `file_path`, so it does not record real project-settings reloads.
  WHY: After a settings sync, the loaded-settings record retains the old hash and triggers an unnecessary Settings restart and possible escalation even when Claude Code reloaded the settings.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/settings_load_recorder.py:86-88,107 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The template copy has the same ConfigChange payload field mismatch as the in-repo recorder.
  WHY: Consumer repos receiving this copy will fail to record real project-settings reloads, leaving a stale hash and triggering unnecessary restarts and escalations.
- tests/test_settings_load_recorder.py:127-153 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The ConfigChange tests use `config_source` and `config_file_path` rather than the real `source` and `file_path` fields, masking the recorder’s payload mismatch.
  WHY: The tests pass while real ConfigChange events are dropped; severity was reported as MAJOR by some reviewers and BLOCKER by others, so the highest severity is retained.
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:Settings restart section, item 1 "Write nothing more for this work here" and item 3 "Start the fresh session" | severity=medium | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The restart flow drops the unpushed sync merge, then has the fresh session repeat checkout and sync on the same branch, causing the settings check to fail again and escalate.
  WHY: A branch whose settings predate the recorder cannot reach the new wiring through the automated restart flow and instead requires a human to push the merge.
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:"## Notes" line referencing `n_proj_synced` in the Step 2 sync merge; and the new "Sync the project branch" bullet | severity=medium | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: An up-to-date branch can skip the merge commit and the required settings check, leaving the session able to push without verifying that the new settings are loaded.
  WHY: The described check depends on a merge commit and no fallback is specified for an up-to-date branch.
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:Step 2 "Sync the project branch" bullet, conflict-handling clause | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Whether the project-branch sync proceeds or aborts depends on whether the settings file watcher happened to fire before the merge.
  WHY: The check’s result is timing-dependent rather than deterministic.
- .claude/hooks/settings_load_recorder.py:write_record() (lines 110-130) | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `write_record` rewrites an identical session record on every applicable SessionStart and ConfigChange event.
  WHY: This creates unnecessary disk I/O and write churn in the loaded-settings directory, though the runtime impact is described as negligible at single-session scale.
- .claude/settings.json:lines 214-225 | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The ConfigChange hook creates per-session records under `~/.claude/loaded-settings/` without a cleanup mechanism.
  WHY: Records accumulate indefinitely across sessions, creating an unbounded but practically minor resource-growth path.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

  expected_change_site: docs/implement-plan/issue-5259-restart-after-settings-sync.md post-merge handling
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: The progress log records that the completion PR or final-merge stage was skipped (docs/implement-plan/issue-5259-restart-after-settings-sync.md:35, docs/implement-plan/issue-5259-restart-after-settings-sync.md lines 35-40, docs/implement-plan/issue-5259-restart-after-settings-sync.md line 39), yet says the issue is closed by that stage (docs/implement-plan/issue-5259-restart-after-settings-sync.md:71); it also records that no stage session resumes the chain (docs/implement-plan/issue-5259-restart-after-settings-sync.md:89). PR #5283 references #5259 rather than closing it, and `.github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml` only closes standalone issues for a default-branch merge; no alternate close actor or step is recorded.
- requirement: "A hook records, per session, the sha256 of the `.claude/settings.json` the session loaded: at SessionStart for `startup` / `resume` / `fork` (a process that read the file at start), and at every `ConfigChange` for `project_settings` (a change the watcher detected). `clear` and `compact` record nothing."
  expected_change_site: .claude/hooks/settings_load_recorder.py `settings_path()` and `build_record()` for the ConfigChange branch
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The implementation reads `config_source` and `config_file_path` instead of the documented `source` and `file_path`, so it does not record the required project-settings ConfigChange events.
- requirement: "A check that gates work after a merge must run before a conflicted merge is resolved, not after its commit"
  expected_change_site: .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md Step 5 conflict-handling text and the Settings restart flow
  confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: Step 5 runs the check mid-merge before resolution, but the restart flow discards the unpushed merge and gives the fresh session no path to receive the merged settings in a way the check can confirm.

  WHY: The recorder keeps the pre-merge hash, causing the loaded-settings check to report "not current" and trigger a Settings restart and eventual escalation.

- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: The PR body says "The base is not the default branch, so the issue is closed explicitly." The `docs/implement-plan/issue-5259-restart-after-settings-sync.md` progress log at line 71 also records "the issue is closed explicitly by the final-merge stage."
  Expected change site: A recorded mechanism (session, workflow step, or documented operator step) that closes issue #5259 after PR #5283 auto-merges into the non-default `claude/implement-plan-issue-4952-sync-claude-assets-at-session-start` branch.
  Evidence of absence: The single-issue shortcut (operator Q30/Q33) skipped the completion PR and its final-merge stage. The progress log at line 39 records "## Completion - Skipped by operator decision Q30/Q33 (2026-10-01): no completion PR", and line 89 records "no stage session resumes this chain." PR #5283 uses `Refs #5259`, not `Fixes #5259`, so GitHub will not auto-close on merge. `.github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml` at line 453 gates close on `PR_BASE_REF = "main"` for standalone issues, and PR #5283 merges into a non-main project branch. CLAUDE.md §26.D says the hand-back on merge writes a terminal report, not an issue close. The progress log records no alternative close actor or step. Issue #5259 remains open indefinitely after the security fix lands.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
